title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Discover the unique rituals and long-standing traditions that define the student experience at Claremont McKenna College, from birthday pondings to Renaissance feasts.

cards.title: Birthday Ponding
cards.subtitle: A Refreshing Birthday Surprise
cards.notes: Friends carry the birthday student to one of the campus fountains for a surprise dunking. It is a rite of passage for every CMCer during their four years.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing CMC tradition where students are thrown into campus fountains on their birthdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Ponding is a well-documented tradition at Claremont McKenna College where students are dunked in fountains on their birthdays.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions - Old and New · CMC Campus Stories
cards.access_notes: Occurs spontaneously at various campus fountains throughout the academic year.

cards.title: Ath Tea
cards.subtitle: Afternoon Treats and Conversation
cards.notes: Gather at the 'Ath' every afternoon for free tea and famous Rice Krispie treats. It is a daily social hub for students and faculty to mingle before evening lectures.
cards.short_summary: A daily afternoon tea service at the Marian Miner Cook Athenaeum featuring snacks and social interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: Athenaeum Tea, or 'Ath Tea,' is one of CMC's longest-standing traditions, occurring daily at the Marian Miner Cook Athenaeum.
cards.access_notes: Open to the CMC community Monday through Friday afternoons during the semester.

cards.title: Madrigal Feast
cards.subtitle: A Renaissance Holiday Celebration
cards.notes: Experience a multi-course medieval dinner complete with court jesters and choral performances. This annual December event transforms the Ath into a royal hall.
cards.short_summary: An annual Renaissance-themed holiday dinner theater event held at the Athenaeum.
cards.evidence_claim: The Madrigal Feast is an annual holiday tradition at CMC featuring medieval food, music, and entertainment at the Athenaeum.
cards.source_title: It's Time Again For Madrigal Feast - Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Ticketed event held over several nights in early December; student pricing available.

cards.title: Monte Carlo Night
cards.subtitle: High Stakes and Formal Attire
cards.notes: Dress up for CMC's longest-running social event featuring casino games and dancing. This fall tradition has been a campus staple since 1949.
cards.short_summary: A formal casino-themed night that is the longest-running social tradition at CMC.
cards.evidence_claim: Monte Carlo Night began in 1949 and remains a signature annual casino-themed social event at CMC.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions - Old and New · CMC Campus Stories
cards.access_notes: Typically held in the fall semester; open to all CMC students.

cards.title: 6:01 Party
cards.subtitle: The Start of the Social Year
cards.notes: Celebrate the end of the first week of classes with this massive outdoor gathering on Green Beach. It traditionally marks the conclusion of 'dry week' for the campus.
cards.short_summary: An annual party on Green Beach that marks the end of the first week of the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: The 6:01 party is a traditional event held on Green Beach to celebrate the end of the first week of classes.
cards.access_notes: Held on the first Saturday evening of the fall semester on Green Beach.

cards.title: Pirate Party
cards.subtitle: A Swashbuckling Spring Tradition
cards.notes: Don your best eye patch for this massive spring event featuring pirate-themed decor and music. It is one of the most anticipated social gatherings of the year.
cards.short_summary: A large-scale, pirate-themed social event held annually in the spring.
cards.evidence_claim: Pirate Party is a signature annual tradition at CMC, typically held in the spring and known for its high attendance.
cards.source_title: Despite Controversy, CMC Pirate Party to be 5C Event - The Student Life
cards.access_notes: Annual spring event; access policies for non-CMC students vary by year.

cards.title: Thursday Night Club (TNC)
cards.subtitle: The Weekly Social Anchor
cards.notes: Join the weekly themed party hosted by different dorms every Thursday night. It is the primary mid-week social outlet for the CMC community.
cards.short_summary: A weekly themed social event hosted by CMC dorms every Thursday night.
cards.evidence_claim: Thursday Night Club (TNC) is a weekly party tradition at CMC, typically hosted by a different dorm each week.
cards.access_notes: Occurs every Thursday night during the academic year at rotating campus locations.

cards.title: Wedding Party
cards.subtitle: A Mock Nuptial Celebration
cards.notes: Attend this elaborate mock wedding ceremony where students dress in formal bridal party attire. It is a satirical and highly produced social event.
cards.short_summary: A large-scale mock wedding social event that is a staple of the CMC social calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wedding Party is a recognized social tradition at CMC involving a mock wedding ceremony and celebration.
cards.source_title: OPINION: CMC students can change party culture - The Student Life
cards.access_notes: Annual themed social event; check ASCMC calendar for dates.

cards.title: The Stag Mascot
cards.subtitle: Symbol of CMC Athletics
cards.notes: Look for the Stag at athletic events and campus celebrations. Adopted in 1957, the mascot represents the joint athletic program with Harvey Mudd College.
cards.short_summary: The official mascot for CMC's men's athletic teams, the Stags.
cards.evidence_claim: The Stag was adopted as the mascot for CMC-HMC athletic teams in 1957.
cards.source_title: How CMS teams became the Stags and Athenas | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Visible at CMS athletic games and major campus events like Family Weekend.

cards.title: Family Weekend Photo Op
cards.subtitle: Memories with the Mascot
cards.notes: Snap a photo with the Stag and Athena mascots during the annual Family Weekend. It is a favorite tradition for visiting families to document their campus visit.
cards.short_summary: A recurring event during Family Weekend where families take photos with campus mascots.
cards.evidence_claim: Family Weekend at CMC includes a scheduled photo op with the Stag and Athena mascots at Roberts Pavilion.
cards.source_title: Family Weekend Schedule - Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Held annually in February; photo ops are typically scheduled at Roberts Pavilion.
